newsitem.title: USA: SFX exec gets control of Multi-Market.
newsitem.headline: SFX exec gets control of Multi-Market.

text.p: Multi-Market Radio Inc said on Wednesday that Robert F.X. Sillerman, executive chairman of SFX Broadcasting Inc had obtained voting control of MMR.
SFX said in April it would acquire MMR by issuing 2.99 million Class A common shares and other equity equivalents.

MMR said in a statement Sillerman had "converted his non-voting stock into 493,334 shares of Class B Common Stock which has 10 votes per share on most matters, thereby giving Sillerman voting control of MMR."
Since MMR's formation in 1993, Sillerman has held one of the two largest economic interests in MMR.

Sillerman's non-voting interest in MMR comprised 360,000 shares of Class C Common Stock and 133,334 shares of Preferred Stock. The Class B Common Stock has 10 votes per share and the publicly held Class A Common Stock has one vote per share on most matters.

As a result of the conversions, Sillerman is deemed to be the beneficial owner of shares representing about 53.5 percent of the combined voting power of MMR. Under limited circumstances, including MMR's pending merger with SFX, the Class B Common Stock will have only one vote per share. Thus, in connection with the approval of the merger, Sillerman holds shares representing about 17.6 percent of the combined voting power of MMR.
Sillerman's conversion of Class C Common Stock and Preferred Stock into Class B Common Stock was approved by the Federal Communications Commission.
